entries.title: Native compression dependency cannot find zlib headers
entries.root_cause: The runner lacks zlib development headers required to compile the ezstd dependency's native source. Install the zlib development package in the build environment.

entries.title: Settlement rounding assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The settlement calculation rounds a half-cent down while the test expects it to round up. Correct the settlement rounding behavior.
